description: Three unnumbered frames with large overlaps (lines 20-24 are seen by all three). Line 3: seen once, marked uncertain, so it keeps the uncertain flag. Line 15: frame 1 reads it correctly; frame 2 (later) reads '{Iast_error}' and marks it uncertain, so the certain reading wins (§9.4 step 2). Line 22: frames 1 and 2 agree; frame 3 (latest) misreads 'atternpts' confidently, so the majority wins (step 3). Line 38: frame 2 reads '= 5', frame 3 (latest) reads '= 6', both confident: the latest is rendered and the line is a conflict with both alternatives (steps 4-5, REQ-STI-08).
